verses.text: Then David said, "This is where the house of the LORD God will be, and this is where the altar of burnt offering for Israel will be."
David gave orders to gather the foreigners living in Israel. From among them he appointed stonecutters to cut blocks of stone for building God's temple.
David provided a large amount of iron for nails and fittings for the doors of the gates, and more bronze than could be weighed.
He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, because the people of Sidon and Tyre had brought large amounts of cedar to David.

David said, "My son Solomon is young and has no experience, and the house to be built for the LORD must be very magnificent, famous and glorious in every country. So I will get things ready for it." So David made large preparations before he died.
Then he called his son Solomon and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
David said to Solomon, "My son, I wanted to build a house to honour the name of the LORD my God.
But the LORD's word came to me: 'You have spilled a lot of blood and fought many wars. You will not build a house to honour my name, because you have spilled so much blood on the earth in my sight.
But you will have a son who will be a man of peace. I will give him peace from all his enemies around him. His name will be Solomon, and I will give Israel peace and quiet while he is king.
He is the one who will build a house to honour my name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. I will make the throne of his kingdom over Israel last forever.'
Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and give you success. May you build the house of the LORD your God, as he said you would.
May the LORD give you wisdom and understanding when he puts you in charge of Israel, so that you will keep the law of the LORD your God.
You will be successful if you are careful to obey the laws and rules the LORD gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and brave. Do not be afraid or lose heart.

I have worked hard to provide for the LORD's temple about three thousand four hundred tonnes of gold, thirty-four thousand tonnes of silver, and so much bronze and iron that it cannot be weighed. I have also provided wood and stone, and you may add to them.
You have many workers: stonecutters, masons, and carpenters, and every kind of skilled worker for every kind of job.
There is more gold, silver, bronze, and iron than can be counted. Now get to work, and may the LORD be with you."
Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon. He said to them,
"The LORD your God is with you, isn't he? He has given you peace on every side. He has handed the people of this land over to me, and the land is now under the control of the LORD and his people.

So now, commit your heart and soul to following the LORD your God. Get up and build the holy place of the LORD God. Then you can bring the ark of the LORD's covenant and the holy objects of God into the temple that will be built to honour the LORD's name."
